Well done Dr.
Mignacca, thank you from my dog ​​Cleopatra, to you and all the staff. 🤗👍😍👋 …

I received an email today stating that the clinic will be closing on July 11th. So what now?! My dog ​​is being treated there by Dr. Cicetti (who I'll follow wherever she goes), but what about the rest? They're all wonderful and empathetic, I've had a great time with them and I can't believe they're closing.

Good morning today I took a rabbit for a visit and the vet Penelope told me that there is no doctor who visits rabbits I was disappointed that a vet like Penelope there is no vet it seems strange to me because rabbits are always animals reviews 0

We took our three-month-old kitten with gastrointestinal issues to Penelope Veterinary Clinic and received truly excellent care. We were greeted promptly and professionally, and the problem was identified and resolved promptly. We particularly appreciated the constant follow-up via WhatsApp, which made us feel cared for even after the visit.

I can't give less than 5 stars. From now on, and in the future, I will always take my kitten to this vet. Highly recommended for their expertise, helpfulness, and care for animals.
A very positive experience and a highly recommended clinic, all the staff are caring, empathetic and professional,

Three or maybe four doctors haven't been able to remove a foxtail in my bulldog puppy's ear. I arrive at the clinic and am assisted by a doctor who, as soon as he examines my dog, reassures me that the foxtail is clearly visible and easily removable. This wasn't the case, so much so that the rush to get off work worsens the situation, pushing it even further down.
Not satisfied, she gets help from a colleague, but again nothing... but she goes to change in the meantime. She comes back, changed, without a gown and tries to remove it again, but nothing... at that point an anesthetist intervenes and, after having already administered two anesthesias without removing it, tries. But with poor results. They tell me the problem is the instruments aren't suitable for removing the foxtail. How does it end? They sedate my dog ​​again, we're up to three anesthesias, and I think they take her to the operating room to check through a monitor and remove it again. But listen, listen... Nothing! They gave me my bulla back, completely stunned by all the anesthesia. Yet another colleague told me she tried to remove it, but unfortunately it broke completely and remained in her ear. So they sent me somewhere else because they needed an endoscopist to remove it. I laughed because the last doctor thought I was making her sound so wrong. But I'm not like that; I'm doing this publicly.
Now, the moral of the story: I went somewhere else. I should add that I also asked to examine my dog ​​because he had some spots on his skin, and they said they didn't know what it was. I had to go back... I'll conclude by saying that, besides paying €80 just because I'm a woman, you don't even deserve one star.

At the other clinic, they examined me, removed the foxtail, and did all the allergy tests for €67. And with qualified staff.

Best regards

Diana Barbagallo
Terrible, it cost €190.00 for blood tests and 2 x-rays, 1 of which was unnecessary, for a paw on a small dog, of course they will never see me again and I will only give bad publicity
Very good
Doctors who leave for who knows why, I agree with you, terrible! And the lady at reception, I think her name is Martina, super unpleasant, to be avoided at all costs!
I also agree with her, they are unprofessional, even on the cleaning inside, a stratospheric smell and other things to avoid
They are unprofessional
Competent and helpful vets. I recommend them to everyone.
Competent

I still don't know, I have an appointment on November 6th!! I'll let you know then!! The visit was completed, the staff was kind and knowledgeable, a little late with the appointments, the specialist visit was professional, I was satisfied, I'll try it!! Parking is nearby.

Exceptional clinic, competent, kind, and humble doctors and nurses. They cared for us and helped us through everything, and were there for us until the very end. All they do for the young patients and their families is not to be taken for granted. We can never thank them enough for everything they did for us.
Everyone is professional and very kind. For my first time there, I found the staff to be helpful and very competent. I've found my trusted clinic.
The staff is kind, attentive and very knowledgeable.
Very kind staff, professional and humane veterinarians
Truly a great person

Welcoming, well-maintained, and clean place. From the receptionist to the doctor, everyone was very polite and competent. First visit, for my 3-month-old kitten, and he didn't come home traumatized! 😁 I highly recommend it, you won't be disappointed. (Check out their website, it's worth it.) …
I found neither courtesy nor empathy nor love for animals. It's all about profit. I strongly advise against it.
They're always kind and helpful. They saved the lives of our two cats, Loki and Thor. Great job. ❤️❤️
Kindness and competence

Serious and talented professionals.
Dr. Andrea Rettagliati is simply fantastic.

What can I say? They're well-prepared and very competent. They managed to do an ultrasound on my dog, who doesn't like vet visits. I recommend making an appointment well in advance; they see a lot of patients and there's a long wait. Very satisfied, I recommend them!

The entire staff is lovely, super fast, punctual, and always smiling!
Special mention to Dr. Ermanno Esposito, who took impeccable care of my dog's teeth.
Thank you all 🥰 …

They're just there to make money! I took my dog ​​with leishmaniasis... a checkup, routine tests, and so far, everything was fine... at the next checkup, they gave me a series of completely meaningless tests that were of little use in treating the disease... once I expressed my concerns, they told me they weren't necessary, that they'd only prescribed them for a basic checkup... we went ahead with the treatment, which was totally ineffective... more tests... more money, but mostly, yet another waste of time... And so it went for months...
I don't recommend them!

The director is an incredibly experienced veterinarian who takes environmental and behavioral aspects into account, as well as physiological ones, and ensures the animal is stressed as little as possible. The clinic is clean, with a nearby garage that charges €2 an hour, and I highly recommend it because parking is otherwise impossible.
So kind and professional 😊😊😊 …
Number 1. Excellent doctors and kind staff. Congratulations!
Very satisfied, competent doctors and all the very kind staff!!!

Just one comment: unique! I had a great time with all the vets I met, especially Dr. Giulia and Dr. Tiziana (I don't remember their surnames). They were particularly empathetic and supportive when I lost my dog ​​Gemma. All the doctors were very knowledgeable, too! Even the sonographer and the surgeon! And on a super positive note, the secretaries were always kind and helpful! ❤️ They've become my trusted clinic now!
Excellent.
Dr. Mignacca is truly scrupulous, my dog ​​is being treated for a mast cell tumor in his hind limb and heart problems, truly competent.
They're so lovely, so kind, and so knowledgeable. Even though I have to drive across town to get there, I know my cats are getting and will get the best care!
Great professionalism combined with kindness and empathy towards the young patients and their owners. Impeccable welcome and care in providing information. Excellent impression.
First visit with Dr. Mignacca today, I'd say it's an excellent approach! Little 4-month-old Leon will have to come back for his vaccinations, I'll keep you updated 😉 …
I thank Dr. Mignacca so much for her professionalism and empathy, and for being there for me as my cat passed over the bridge 🐈. Thanks to all the staff. 😺 …

Very punctual with appointments.
Dr. Roberta does her job with true enthusiasm.

They saved my dog ​​from a nasty pyometra infection years ago. Subsequently, the same little girl developed type B lymphoma. They immediately referred me to the right treatment, but unfortunately, this terrible disease took its toll.

Today, sweet Lana no longer wags her tail among us, but thanks to the expertise and love of these fantastic doctors and nurses, she was able to live the last year and a half of her life in complete serenity.

And now, the new arrivals Devola and Popola recently met their aunts for their vaccinations :)
Serious and well-prepared professionals. Great humanity. I highly recommend the clinic and I am infinitely grateful to Dr. Mignacca.
Highly recommended, great prices and the vets there really love animals and not money like other hypocrites, my dog ​​is happy to go there, does that mean something? 😉❤️ …
